data.name: Introduction: Worlds Collide

entries: Welcome, adventurer! You've come just in the nick of time. I am known as Chronormu, but you can call me Chromie. I am comfortable with such familiarity. But perhaps you already knew that. Have we met before, or am I simply remembering that we shall meet again?

You see, I am one of the bronze dragonflight, forever attuned to the ebb and flow of time. My job is to keep tabs on certain timelines—the really important ones—to make sure things unfold the right way. Which is to say, the way they already unfolded. Or is it the way they will unfold?

Anyway, can you keep a secret? The truth is, messing with time is actually super fun. What if two fierce rivals never met? What if they teamed up and became a heroic duo? What if they fell in love but their romance was forbidden by their families? So many possibilities.

So this codex is something I whipped up as a fun way to explore all those what-if questions without risking any actual damage to the timelines. With this book, we can delve into the secrets of Azeroth like never before! Together, we can jump into these pages to view different versions of Azeroth's past, present, and future as if we were really there!

Oh, and don't worry! I'm almost entirely sure that this codex is absolutely, nearly one hundred percent stable! There's practically no chance of your adventures causing any significant snarls in any important timestreams.
So what do you say? Adventure awaits!

This book is a union of two worlds in more than one sense: D&D: {@i World of Warcraft} is the meeting of the multiverse of D&D with the world of Azeroth (and connected realms), as well as the meeting of the world of tabletop roleplaying games with the world of massively multiplayer online roleplaying games. This fruitful collaboration brings new dimensions to your exploration of the world of Azeroth and new ideas to your D&D gaming table.

To make best use of this book, you need the Dungeons & Dragons {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}, {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}, and {@book Monster Manual|XMM}. But you can also get started with the resources available on {@link DnDBeyond.com|https://www.dndbeyond.com/}, including ready-made characters and free basic rules.

entries.name: What Is D&D?
entries: This book is a setting supplement for Dungeons & Dragons, the original and still the greatest tabletop roleplaying game (TRPG). If you're familiar with the {@i World of Warcraft} online game, you already know the basic idea of D&D: Players create characters and explore a fantasy world, using magic and weapons to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. But the action in D&D takes place primarily in the players' imaginations at a physical or virtual game table. One player takes on the role of Dungeon Master (DM), providing narration that sets the scene and determining the outcomes of the player characters' actions.

If you're a WoW fan, this book invites you to take your exploration of the world of Azeroth to a new level. As you travel across Kalimdor or the Eastern Kingdoms, sail to Northrend or the Dragon Isles, and venture into the dungeons detailed in this book (or dungeons of your DM's creation), you can interact with anything you can see, talk to anyone you meet, and try anything you can imagine. And because the game unfolds in the players' imaginations, anything can happen.

If you play as the DM, this book gives you tools to create your own adventures in Azeroth. Those stories might echo the themes and characters from WoW, or they might draw on existing elements to create entirely new adventures to make Azeroth your own.
Here's a glimpse of what a D&D game looks like:

{@b Jared (as Dungeon Master):} Seated at the table, apparently waiting for you, is a hulking tauren with enormous moose-like antlers. He stands as you enter and says, "Greetings, adventurers. I am Spiritwalker Ebonhorn. Mayla has told me much about you."
{@b Phillip (as Delenus):} Does his name mean anything to me?
{@b Maeve (as Maiatsumi):} Can I get a read on this guy? What's his deal?

items.name: Jared:
items.entry: All right, one at a time. Phillip, Delenus is searching his memory for any knowledge of Ebonhorn?

items.name: Phillip:
items.entry: Yeah. And what's a spiritwalker?

items.name: Jared:
items.entry: Make an Intelligence check.

items.name: Phillip:
items.entry: Does my Religion skill apply?

items.name: Jared:
items.entry: Sure, at least as far as what "spiritwalker" means.

entries: {@b Phillip (rolling a {@dice d20}):} Ugh. Seven.

items.name: Jared:
items.entry: It must be a Highmountain tauren thing. Means nothing to you. And Maeve, you're trying to get a read on him?

items.name: Maeve:
items.entry: Yeah. Maybe using Insight?

items.name: Jared:
items.entry: Sure, make a Wisdom (Insight) check.

entries: {@b Maeve (rolling a {@dice d20}):} Nineteen! Plus... well, plus zero is still nineteen!

The adventure continues from there, relying on the DM's descriptions to set the scenes and on the players' decisions to determine how the action unfolds. You can learn more about D&D—including more examples of play, {@link free rules|https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024}, and ready-to-play characters you can use to start your adventures in Azeroth—by visiting {@link DnDBeyond.com|https://www.dndbeyond.com/}.

entries.name: What Is World of Warcraft?
entries: {@i World of Warcraft} (WoW) is a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game (MMORPG, usually shortened to MMO)—an online video game where many, many people enter into a fantasy world, through the avatars of their characters, and explore that world in groups or independently. From the perspective of a D&D player, WoW is a treasure trove of lore and inspiration—a world that feels both familiar and uniquely new. Adventurers of familiar species such as elves and dwarves travel alongside less familiar folk such as pandaren and tauren. And the history of WoW's night elves, blood elves, and three main dwarf clans—and the dwarves' ties to the ancient titans—sets them apart from their counterparts in D&D.

With over twenty years of the {@i World of Warcraft} MMO (plus multiple real-time strategy games in the {@i Warcraft} line before that), the story of the world of Azeroth is long and deep. This book only scratches the surface of that rich lore. The official World of Warcraft website ({@link worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com|https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com}) offers a starting point where you can learn more about the world and the MMO, while fan-made wikis—readily discoverable in any online search engine—carefully chronicle the details of these decades of stories. The "{@area Where to Learn More|006|x}" sidebar includes a list of resources to help you learn more about the world of Azeroth.

entries.title: Chromie waits for adventurers near the Stormwind Embassy.

entries.name: Inside This Book
entries: D&D: {@i World of Warcraft} is a guide to creating characters and adventures in the world of Azeroth.

{@book Chapter 1|WoW|1} focuses on the thirteen character classes in the {@i World of Warcraft} MMO. Each is presented in alphabetical order, with an explanation of how to build and play that class as a D&D character. That explanation points you to one of the twelve classes in the D&D {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}, but it includes alterations, new options, and guidance to reflect WoW classes and their specializations. So whether you want to re-create the fury warrior you play in the MMO or make a new character, this chapter is your starting point for playing WoW classes in D&D.

{@book Chapter 2|WoW|2} focuses on character origins, particularly species. Each playable species in the MMO is described here. Some species use rules described in the D&D {@i Player's Handbook}, while other species have new rules. Whether you're playing a human or a vulpera, this chapter has the information you need.
{@book Chapter 3|WoW|3} covers rules and options related to character professions—both gathering and crafting—as well as mounts, pets, and new magic items.

{@book Chapter 4|WoW|4} details important factions of Azeroth, starting with the Alliance and the Horde and their subfactions. The chapter expands on the renown rules in the D&D {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG} to map out the rewards you can gain as you build your reputation with these factions.

{@book Chapter 5|WoW|5} is a brief overview of the world of Azeroth. It includes a summary of each region of the world, suggestions for the kinds of adventure to be found in those locations, and a glimpse at the worlds and planes beyond Azeroth.

{@book Chapter 6|WoW|6}, intended solely for the Dungeon Master, focuses on crafting adventures in the world of Azeroth. It outlines the world's major conflicts and encourages the DM to mix and match those conflicts to create unique adventures and campaigns. It then presents several familiar dungeons from the {@i World of Warcraft} MMO for characters to explore.

{@book Chapter 7|WoW|7}, also intended for the Dungeon Master, includes descriptions and stat blocks for new monsters and important nonplayer characters (NPCs) from the {@i World of Warcraft} MMO. From dragons of the five ordered dragonflights and demons of the Burning Legion to lowly murlocs and furbolgs, this bestiary supplements the D&D {@book Monster Manual|XMM} to provide new adversaries and potential allies for characters in a {@i World of Warcraft} D&D campaign. And if characters want to join forces with {@creature Thrall|WoW} or {@creature Jaina Proudmoore|WoW|Jaina} and test their mettle against {@creature Illidan Stormrage|WoW|Illidan} or {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Arthas}, this chapter provides stat blocks for those legendary characters, among others.

As Chromie suggests at the start of this introduction, this book helps you make Azeroth your own. Just as you would when you start any D&D campaign, you can adapt elements in this book to fit the way you want to play. Chromie has given you a separate timeline as your playground, so make of it whatever you will!

entries.name: Creating a Character
entries: Making a D&D character to explore the world of Azeroth follows the same steps outlined in the {@i Player's Handbook}, but this book provides additional options you can select throughout the process:

items.name: 1: Choose a Class
items.entry: Use the descriptions of {@i World of Warcraft} classes in {@book chapter 1|WoW|1} to guide your class selection.

items.name: 2: Determine Origin
items.entry: Choose a background from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} and a species from {@book chapter 2|WoW|2}. These two elements can combine in interesting ways to make unique origins. Also note your starting Renown Score, if any, from your species.

items.name: 3: Determine Ability Scores
items.entry: Use the Player's Handbook to guide you in this step.

items.name: 4: Choose an Alignment
items.entry: The peoples of the Alliance tend toward Lawful Good alignments, while those of the Horde tend toward Chaotic Good. See {@book chapter 4|WoW|4} for more information.

items.name: 5: Fill in Details
items.entry: Use the Player's Handbook to guide you in this step.

entries.name: Where to Learn More
entries: The books listed here are a great place to dive more deeply into the lore of Azeroth:

entries.name: World of Warcraft: Chronicle
entries: The four volumes in this series offer a comprehensive look at the history of Azeroth and Draenor, covering the stories of every game in the Warcraft franchise and each {@i World of Warcraft} expansion.

entries.name: World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth
entries: This five-book series—Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Northrend, Pandaria, and Islands & Isles—surveys the world of Azeroth, providing more detail on the regions mentioned in {@book chapter 5|WoW|5} of this book.

entries.name: World of Warcraft: Grimoire of the Shadowlands and Beyond
entries: This book provides a tour of the Shadowlands—Warcraft's mysterious afterlife.

entries.name: World of Warcraft: The Dragonflight Codex
entries: This book offers a comprehensive guide to the dragons of Azeroth, as well as to the Dragon Isles.

In addition to these reference books, dozens of novels, short stories, audio dramas, animations, and comics in both the {@i Warcraft} and the {@i World of Warcraft} lines tell the stories of Azeroth in narrative form.
Take care of yourself out there.

data.name: Chapter 1: Character Classes

entries.title: Horde adventurers confront Onyxia in her lair.

entries: Creating a character for a game using this book begins with choosing a class. {@i World of Warcraft} offers thirteen classes, each with a variety of specializations. Each class and specialization maps to certain choices of features from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} plus new options in this book. Three sidebars in the next few pages—"{@area Hero Classes|00e|x}," "{@area Specialization|014|x}," and "{@area Other Class Options|02d|x}"—provide more general information.

entries.name: World of Warcraft Classes
entries: The thirteen {@i World of Warcraft} classes described in this book are summarized below:
{@class Death Knight|WoW}. Straddling the line between life and death, death knights emphasize debilitating curses and sinister magic.
{@class Demon Hunter|WoW}. Demon hunters are haunted outcasts who wield fel magic.
{@class Druid|WoW}. Druids are shape-shifters with an affinity for plants, animals, and the magic of nature.
{@class Evoker|WoW}. Evokers unleash devastating draconic spells on enemies and healing magic on allies.
{@class Hunter|WoW}. Hunters are at home in the wilderness and have a special connection with beasts. Hunters rely on weaponry and pets to deal damage.
{@class Mage|WoW}. Mages are magic-users who learn their craft through intense research and study. They wield a potent array of offensive and defensive spells.
{@class Monk|WoW}. Monks are known for their skill in hand-to-hand fighting, including unarmed combat.
{@class Paladin|WoW}. Paladins are heavily armored defenders whose holy magic heals wounds and combats evil.
{@class Priest|WoW}. Priests express their faith by serving the people as healers and champions.
{@class Rogue|WoW}. Rogues sneak around enemies and attack while hiding to finish foes quickly.
{@class Shaman|WoW}. Shaman wield elemental magic against their foes.
{@class Warlock|WoW}. Warlocks wield demonic magic, including summoned demons, to curse and immolate foes.
{@class Warrior|WoW}. Warriors are heavily armored fighters who strive for perfection in combat.

entries.name: Hero Classes
entries: Three of the {@i World of Warcraft} classes—{@class death knight|WoW}, {@class demon hunter|WoW}, and {@class evoker|WoW}—are hero classes, meaning that they are typically available only to characters starting at level 3 or higher. In the story of {@i World of Warcraft}, characters with these classes are already experienced and powerful adventurers by the time they enter the game.

The {@class death knight|WoW} and the {@class demon hunter|WoW} classes are represented by subclasses (the {@subclass Ebon Blade|Death Knight|WoW|WoW|Oath of the Ebon Blade} {@class Paladin|XPHB} and the {@subclass Demon Hunter|Demon Hunter|WoW|WoW} {@class Ranger|XPHB}, respectively) that alter the character's base class. With your DM's permission, you can start as a level 1 character of one of these classes, but your subclass choice is fixed when you make the character.
Playing an {@class evoker|WoW} doesn't alter the base {@class Sorcerer|XPHB} class, but it slightly alters the {@subclass Draconic|Evoker|WoW|WoW|Draconic Sorcery} subclass.

entries.title: Orc Death Knight

entries.name: Playing a Death Knight
entries: Death knight is a hero class, which means you typically must start play at level 3 or higher (see the "{@area Hero Classes|00e|x}" sidebar). To play a death knight, choose the {@class Paladin|XPHB|Paladin class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} and the {@subclass Ebon Blade|Death Knight|WoW|WoW|Oath of the Ebon Blade} subclass, described below. This subclass alters some of your core Paladin class features beginning at level 1.
As a death knight, you can choose one of three specializations by inscribing the corresponding rune on your weapon using your Runeforging feature: Blood, Frost, or Unholy.

entries.name: Blood Specialization
entries: With the Blood rune, you are a dark guardian who manipulates and corrupts life energy to sustain yourself in the face of an enemy onslaught. The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose {@item Greataxe|XPHB|Greataxes}, {@item Greatsword|XPHB|Greatswords}, or {@item Maul|XPHB|Mauls} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose {@feat Interception|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Great Weapon Fighting|XPHB}, {@feat Great Weapon Master|XPHB}, {@feat Heavy Armor Master|XPHB}, {@feat Piercer|XPHB}, {@feat Slasher|XPHB}, and {@feat Tough|XPHB}.

entries.name: Frost Specialization
entries: Wielding the Frost rune, you are an icy harbinger of doom, channeling runic power and delivering vicious weapon strikes. The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose {@item Light Hammer|XPHB|Light Hammers} or {@item Scimitar|XPHB|Scimitars} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose {@feat Two-Weapon Fighting|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Dual Wielder|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

entries.name: Unholy Specialization
entries: With the Unholy rune, you become a master of death and decay, spreading infection and controlling undead minions. The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose {@item Greataxe|XPHB|Greataxes}, {@item Greatsword|XPHB|Greatswords}, or {@item Maul|XPHB|Mauls} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose {@feat Great Weapon Fighting|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Great Weapon Master|XPHB}, {@feat Piercer|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

entries.name: Specialization
entries: Every class in {@i World of Warcraft} offers options for specializing in different aspects of the class's powers and features. In this book, those specializations are reflected in these ways:

items.name: Subclass Features
items.entry: The {@subclass Ebon Blade|Death Knight|WoW|WoW|Oath of the Ebon Blade} subclass's Runeforging feature reflects the three {@class death knight|WoW} specializations, allowing a character to choose a new specialization with every level gained.

items.name: Feat and Spell Selection
items.entry: Some specializations are represented with different Fighting Style feats; the difference between an arms warrior and a protection warrior is largely a matter of the weapons they use and the corresponding Fighting Styles. Similarly, mage specializations are reflected in the character's spell selection, along with feats that enhance different spells.

items.name: Subclass Choice
items.entry: Often, specializations point to different subclasses within the same class. For example, the {@class monk|WoW} specializations of brewmaster, mistweaver, and windwalker map to three different {@class Monk|WoW} subclasses.

entries.name: Oath of the Ebon Blade (Paladin Subclass)
Other Class Options
entries: Check with your DM if you want to build a character using options that aren't described in this book. For example, while {@class Bard|XPHB} isn't a playable class in {@i World of Warcraft}, many magical musicians dwell on Azeroth, and your DM might allow you to use the {@class Bard|XPHB} class from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. Similarly, your DM can allow or disallow subclasses that aren't referenced in this book (such as {@subclass Aberrant|Sorcerer|XPHB|XPHB|Aberrant Sorcery} or the {@subclass Psi Warrior|Fighter|XPHB|XPHB} {@class Fighter|XPHB}) and the option of multiclassing.

entries.name: Death Knight Spells
entries: The following new spells appear on the Oath of the Ebon Blade Spells table. Although they are {@class Paladin|XPHB} spells, they are available only to {@class Paladin|XPHB|Paladins} with the {@subclass Ebon Blade|Death Knight|WoW|WoW|Oath of the Ebon Blade} subclass. In the Special column, {@i C} means the spell requires Concentration.

entries.title: Illidan Stormrage and Two Demon Hunters Under His Tutelage

entries.name: Playing a Demon Hunter
entries: Demon hunter is a hero class, which means you typically must start play at level 3 or higher (see the "{@area Hero Classes|00e|x}" sidebar earlier in this chapter). To play a demon hunter, choose the {@class Ranger|XPHB|Ranger class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. Your subclass, the {@subclass Demon Hunter|Demon Hunter|WoW|WoW}, alters some of your core Ranger class features.

All demon hunters in {@i World of Warcraft} lore are elves ({@race Elf|WoW|blood elves}, {@race Elf|WoW|night elves}, or {@race Elf|WoW|void elves}), so check with your DM before playing a demon hunter of another species.
As a Demon Hunter, you can choose one of three specializations: Devourer, Havoc, or Vengeance.

entries.name: Devourer Specialization
entries: With the devourer specialization, you harness the power of the Void to crush your enemies and feast on their souls. The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@item Handaxe|XPHB|Handaxes}, {@item Scimitar|XPHB|Scimitars}, or {@item Shortsword|XPHB|Shortswords} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose the Void Warrior option instead of a Fighting Style feat, and choose {@spell Chill Touch|XPHB} and {@spell Mind Sliver|XPHB} as your cantrips.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Choose the Devourer spells from the {@area Demon Hunter Spells table|055|x}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Defensive Duelist|XPHB}, {@feat Mage Slayer|XPHB}, {@feat Shadow-Touched|XPHB|Shadow Touched}, {@feat Slasher|XPHB}, {@feat Speedy|XPHB}, and {@feat Spell Sniper|XPHB}.

entries.name: Havoc Specialization
entries: With the havoc specialization, you are a fierce melee combatant who masters the destructive power of fel magic. The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@item Handaxe|XPHB|Handaxes}, {@item Scimitar|XPHB|Scimitars}, or {@item Shortsword|XPHB|Shortswords} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose {@feat Two-Weapon Fighting|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Choose the Havoc spells from the {@area Demon Hunter Spells table|055|x}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Dual Wielder|XPHB}, {@feat Mage Slayer|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vengeance Specialization
entries: With the vengeance specialization, you embrace the demon within to incinerate your enemies and protect your allies. The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@item Battleaxe|XPHB|Battleaxes} or {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords} for your Weapon Mastery feature. Choose {@feat Interception|XPHB} as your Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Choose the Vengeance spells from the {@area Demon Hunter Spells table|055|x}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Sentinel|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

entries.name: Demon Hunter Warglaives
entries: During the War of the Ancients, Illidan defeated a demonic commander and claimed the demon's weapons—called warglaives—as his own. These later became known as the {@item Twin Blades of Azzinoth|WoW}, and they inspired a whole category of weapons that are favored by demon hunters to this day. Warglaives vary widely in appearance and construction, giving different weapons the game statistics of a {@item Battleaxe|XPHB}, a {@item Handaxe|XPHB}, a {@item Longsword|XPHB}, or a {@item Scimitar|XPHB}.

entries.name: Demon Hunter Spells
entries: The following new spells appear on the Demon Hunter Spells table. Although they are {@class Ranger|XPHB} spells, they are available only to {@class Ranger|XPHB|Rangers} with the {@subclass Demon Hunter|Demon Hunter|WoW|WoW} subclass. In the Special column, {@i C} means the spell requires Concentration, and {@i M} means it requires a specific Material component.

entries.title: A Demon Hunter casts Metamorphosis.
Night Elf Druid

entries.name: Playing a Druid
entries: To play a druid, choose the {@class Druid|XPHB} class from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You can choose one of four specializations to guide your choice of subclass, spells, and feats: balance, feral, guardian, or restoration.
Adopting the {@class Druid|WoW} class, either at character creation or through multiclassing, increases a character's Renown Score with the Cenarion Circle by 3 (see {@area chapter 4|2f9|x}).

entries.name: Balance Specialization
entries: By leveraging the sacred powers of the moons, the sun, and the stars, balance druids keep the elemental forces of the cosmos in an equilibrium. To that end, they wield both celestial spells that deal Radiant damage and nature-oriented spells that deal Acid, Lightning, or Poison damage, striving to keep the world and its celestial powers in balance. They use the shape-shifted form of a {@creature moonkin|WoW}—an owlbear-like creature favored by the moon goddess Elune—to heighten their attunement to these natural forces.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@classFeature Magician|Druid|XPHB|1|XPHB} for your Primal Order feature. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB}, {@spell Starry Wisp|XPHB}, and {@spell Wrath|WoW}. Prepare the following level 1 spells to start: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, {@spell Moonfire|WoW}, and {@spell Thunderwave|XPHB}.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Druid|WoW|Circle of the Stars subclass|Stars|WoW}. When you use {@subclassFeature Starry Form|Druid|XPHB|Stars|XPHB|3|XPHB}, you can take on the appearance of a {@creature moonkin|WoW}, but the other effects are identical.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Elemental Adept|XPHB} and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.caption: Balance Druid Spells
rows: {@spell Call Lightning|XPHB}, {@spell Daylight|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Summon Fey|XPHB}

entries.name: Feral Specialization
entries: To feral druids, nature is an eternal dance between predator and prey, with death an integral part of the cycle that sustains life. These druids seek deeper understanding of this truth by pursuing a visceral connection to the wild. Their favored shape-shifted form is a deadly feline predator—a ferocious, agile stalker that rips, bites, and bleeds enemies dry.
The following choices will help you fill the feral druid's role:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@classFeature Warden|Druid|XPHB|1|XPHB} for your Primal Order feature. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} and {@spell Poison Spray|XPHB}. Prepare the following level 1 spells to start: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB}, and {@spell Thunderwave|XPHB}.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Druid|WoW|Circle of the Moon subclass|Moon|WoW}. When you use {@classFeature Wild Shape|Druid|XPHB|2|XPHB}, you can adopt the {@b Cat Form} stat block below.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Skulker|XPHB}, {@feat Slasher|XPHB}, and {@feat Speedy|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: After you gain {@classFeature Wild Resurgence|Druid|XPHB|5|XPHB} at level 5, giving up a spell slot to gain another use of Wild Shape is often worthwhile. But consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.caption: Feral Druid Spells
rows: {@spell Feral Prowl|WoW}, {@spell Pass Without Trace|XPHB}, {@spell Summon Beast|XPHB}

entries.name: Classic Druid Beast Forms
entries: The beast forms that every druid in {@i World of Warcraft} learns are Cat Form, Bear Form, and Travel Form (including Aquatic Form and Flight Form).

entries.name: Cat Form
entries: If you have the {@class Druid|WoW|Circle of the Moon subclass|Moon|WoW}, use the Cat Form stat block described above. If not, you can become a {@creature Panther|XMM} at level 2 and a {@creature Tiger|XMM} at level 8.

entries.name: Bear Form
entries: If you have the {@class Druid|WoW|Circle of the Moon subclass|Moon|WoW}, use the Bear Form stat block described above. If not, you can become a {@creature Black Bear|XMM} at level 4 and a {@creature Brown Bear|XMM} at level 8.

entries.name: Travel Form
entries: You can become an {@creature Elk|XMM} starting at level 2. For fast swimming, consider a {@creature Giant Seahorse|XMM} starting at level 4 (or level 3 for the Circle of the Moon). When you gain access to flying forms at level 8, you can become an {@creature Eagle|XMM}, a {@creature Giant Bat|XMM}, a {@creature Hawk|XMM}, a {@creature Pteranodon|XMM}, or a {@creature Raven|XMM}.

entries.name: Guardian Specialization
entries: Guardian druids commune with the wild to better understand how life perseveres through adversity. These druids deeply value steadfastness and meet danger with fierce resistance. They prefer the shape-shifted form of a great bear—a massive wall of fur, claws, teeth, and rage aided by the magic of nature to protect their allies from danger.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@classFeature Warden|Druid|XPHB|1|XPHB} for your Primal Order feature. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} and {@spell Thorn Whip|XPHB}. Prepare the following level 1 spells to start: {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, {@spell Healing Word|XPHB}, {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB}, and {@spell Thunderwave|XPHB}.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Druid|WoW|Circle of the Moon subclass|Moon|WoW}. When you use {@classFeature Wild Shape|Druid|XPHB|2|XPHB}, you can adopt the {@b Bear Form} stat block above.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Sentinel|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: After you gain {@classFeature Wild Resurgence|Druid|XPHB|5|XPHB} at level 5, giving up a spell slot to gain another use of Wild Shape is often worthwhile. But consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: Restoration Specialization
entries: Restoration druids tend to the life-forms of the world, celebrating birth and growth in search of order and harmony. Where there is decay and devastation, these druids bring rejuvenation and regrowth. Life, in their view, needs not only protection, but also nourishment. To that end, they bond with living and growing things, seeking inspiration from the flower's bloom, the seed's sprout, the mushroom's spores, and the tree's towering growth.
Like nature itself, restoration druids persevere through patience, and they wield their nature-given power to mend wounds and protect their allies.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@classFeature Magician|Druid|XPHB|1|XPHB} for your Primal Order feature. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB}, {@spell Produce Flame|XPHB}, and {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB}. Prepare the following level 1 spells to start: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Entangle|XPHB}, {@spell Goodberry|XPHB}, and {@spell Healing Word|XPHB}.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Druid|WoW|Circle of the Land subclass|Land|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Chef|XPHB}, {@feat Healer|XPHB}, {@feat Inspiring Leader|XPHB}, and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.caption: Restoration Druid Spells
rows: {@spell Aid|XPHB}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Protection from Poison|XPHB}

entries: Like a dragon's visage, a druid's beast form reflects something of their true nature.

entries.name: Druid Spells
entries: The following new spells are added to the Druid spell list for {@i World of Warcraft} druids. In the Special column, {@i C} means the spell requires Concentration.

entries.title: Bella Wilder, a Druid of the Cenarion Circle
Dracthyr Evoker

entries.name: Playing an Evoker
entries: Evoker is a hero class, which means you typically start play at level 3 or higher (see the "{@area Hero Classes|00e|x}" sidebar earlier in this chapter). To play an evoker, choose the {@class Sorcerer|XPHB|Sorcerer class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} and the {@class Evoker|WoW|Draconic Sorcery subclass|Draconic|WoW} at level 3. Instead of the {@subclassFeature Draconic Spells|Sorcerer|XPHB|Draconic|XPHB|3|XPHB} subclass feature, you gain the Evoker Spells feature, described below. You can use one of three specializations to guide your choice of class features, spells, Metamagic options, and feats: augmentation, devastation, or preservation.
All evokers in {@i World of Warcraft} are {@race dracthyr|WoW}, so check with your DM before playing an evoker of another species.

entries.name: Augmentation Specialization
entries: Evokers who specialize in augmentation imbue their companions with the might of the black dragonflight, amplifying those allies' abilities. They can also bend time and fate to their advantage using the magic of the bronze dragonflight.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Evoker|WoW|Draconic Sorcery subclass|Draconic|WoW}, and see "Evoker Spells" above. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Elementalism|XPHB}, {@spell Light|XPHB}, {@spell Sorcerous Burst|XPHB}, and {@spell Thunderclap|XPHB}. Choose the Augmentation spells from the Evoker Spells table and the following additional prepared spells: {@spell Arcane Vigor|XPHB}, {@spell Enhance Ability|XPHB}, {@spell Flaming Sphere|XPHB}, {@spell Ice Knife|XPHB}, {@spell Living Flame|WoW}, and {@spell Shield|XPHB}. Choose {@optfeature Empowered Spell|XPHB} and {@optfeature Extended Spell|XPHB} for your Metamagic options.

items.name: Level 6
items.entry: Choose Fire for your {@subclassFeature Elemental Affinity|Sorcerer|XPHB|Draconic|XPHB|6|XPHB}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Elemental Adept|XPHB} (Fire), {@feat Speedy|XPHB}, {@feat Spell Sniper|XPHB}, and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: Devastation Specialization
entries: The devastation specialization uses the chaotic flames of the red dragonflight and the precise arcane power of the blue dragons to bathe the battlefield in destruction. Devastation evokers can rain fire down from the sky on their foes and maneuver quickly around the battlefield.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Evoker|WoW|Draconic Sorcery subclass|Draconic|WoW}, and see "Evoker Spells" above. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Elementalism|XPHB}, {@spell Light|XPHB}, {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB}, and {@spell Sorcerous Burst|XPHB}. Choose the Devastation spells from the Evoker Spells table and the following additional prepared spells: {@spell Arcane Vigor|XPHB}, {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB}, {@spell Cloud of Daggers|XPHB}, {@spell Flame Blade|XPHB}, {@spell Ice Knife|XPHB}, and {@spell Living Flame|WoW}. Choose {@optfeature Empowered Spell|XPHB} and {@optfeature Transmuted Spell|XPHB} for your Metamagic options.

items.name: Level 6
items.entry: Choose Cold or Fire for your {@subclassFeature Elemental Affinity|Sorcerer|XPHB|Draconic|XPHB|6|XPHB}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Elemental Adept|XPHB} (Cold and Fire), {@feat Spell Sniper|XPHB}, and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: Preservation Specialization
entries: Evokers who specialize in preservation wield the power of the Emerald Dream—the fey realm of verdant life tended by the green dragonflight—to rejuvenate injured allies. They also use bronze dragons' magic to manipulate the sands of time, preventing harm and rewinding injury.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Evoker|WoW|Draconic Sorcery subclass|Draconic|WoW}, and see "Evoker Spells" above. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Blade Ward|XPHB}, {@spell Elementalism|XPHB}, {@spell Light|XPHB}, and {@spell Sorcerous Burst|XPHB}. Choose the Preservation spells from the Evoker Spells table and the following additional prepared spells: {@spell Alter Self|XPHB}, {@spell Arcane Vigor|XPHB}, {@spell False Life|XPHB}, {@spell Hold Person|XPHB}, {@spell Ray of Sickness|XPHB}, and {@spell Witch Bolt|XPHB}. Choose {@optfeature Heightened Spell|XPHB} and {@optfeature Twinned Spell|XPHB} for your Metamagic options.

items.name: Level 6
items.entry: Choose Lightning or Poison for your {@subclassFeature Elemental Affinity|Sorcerer|XPHB|Draconic|XPHB|6|XPHB}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Elemental Adept|XPHB} (Lightning and Poison), {@feat Spell Sniper|XPHB}, and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.title: Dwarf Hunter with a Bear Companion

entries.name: Playing a Hunter
entries: To play a hunter, choose the {@class Ranger|XPHB|Ranger class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You can choose one of three specializations to guide your choice of subclass, spells, and feats: beast mastery, marksmanship, or survival.

entries.name: Beast Mastery Specialization
entries: From childhood, many hunters have formed profound bonds with the beasts of the wild. These hunters specialize in beast mastery. They are drawn to the primal world and invigorated by the dangerous wilds. Wilderness landscapes become their homes, and ferocious predators become their kin. To aid them in hunting and in battling foes, these hunters summon and command a wide array of vicious animals to fight at their side.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose the following prepared spells: {@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB} and {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB}. Choose any two of {@item Heavy Crossbow|XPHB|Heavy Crossbows}, {@item Longbow|XPHB|Longbows}, or {@item Musket|XPHB|Muskets} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 2
items.entry: Choose {@feat Archery|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Hunter|WoW|Beast Master subclass|Beast Master|WoW}. See "Hunter Pets" below.

items.name: Level 6
items.entry: Instead of the {@classFeature Roving|Ranger|XPHB|6|XPHB} class feature, you gain the Pet Specialization feature (see below).

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Crossbow Expert|XPHB}, {@feat Medium Armor Master|XPHB}, {@feat Piercer|XPHB}, {@feat Sharpshooter|XPHB}, and {@feat Weapon Master|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: Marksmanship Specialization
entries: Some hunters forgo the companionship of a wild beast, preferring to blend into the natural environment as they wield ranged weapons with deadly skill. Specializing in marksmanship, these hunters learn techniques for stalking and ambushing their prey by observing the deadliest predators of the wilds. They prefer to remain in hiding as they unleash their shots with deadly precision.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose the following prepared spells: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB}. Choose any two of {@item Heavy Crossbow|XPHB|Heavy Crossbows}, {@item Longbow|XPHB|Longbows}, or {@item Musket|XPHB|Muskets} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 2
items.entry: Choose {@feat Archery|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Hunter|WoW|Hunter subclass|Hunter|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Crossbow Expert|XPHB}, {@feat Medium Armor Master|XPHB}, {@feat Piercer|XPHB}, and {@feat Sharpshooter|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.caption: Marksmanship Hunter Spells
rows: {@spell Conjure Barrage|XPHB}, {@spell Lightning Arrow|XPHB}, {@spell Serpent Sting|WoW}

entries.name: Survival Specialization
entries: Some hunters are drawn to the most brutal aspects of nature: the unrelenting ferocity of predatory animals and the merciless bloodshed that means survival for the strongest. These hunters prefer close-quarters combat, wielding spears and polearms to bring down their prey. They call on the aid of beast companions, coat their weapons with venom, and lay deceptive traps.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose the following prepared spells: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Ensnaring Strike|XPHB}. Choose any two of {@item Glaive|XPHB|Glaives}, {@item Halberd|XPHB|Halberds}, or {@item Pike|XPHB|Pikes} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 2
items.entry: Choose {@feat Great Weapon Fighting|XPHB} for a Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Hunter|WoW|Beast Master subclass|Beast Master|WoW}. See "Hunter Pets" below.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Great Weapon Master|XPHB}, {@feat Poisoner|XPHB}, {@feat Polearm Master|XPHB}, and {@feat Sentinel|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: Hunter Pets
entries: As a Beast Master (whether you choose the beast mastery or survival specialization), when you use your {@subclassFeature Primal Companion|Ranger|XPHB|Beast Master|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature to summon a primal beast, you choose the form it takes from among the pet families shown on the table below. Each family has three characteristics:

items.name: Stat Block
items.entry: Your primal beast's family determines which one of the stat blocks in the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} it uses: {@creature Beast of the Land|XPHB}, {@creature Beast of the Sea|XPHB}, or {@creature Beast of the Sky|XPHB}.

items.name: Specialization (Spec.)
items.entry: Each pet family has a specialization—Cunning (C), Ferocity (F), or Tenacity (T)—that comes into play only if you have the {@subclassFeature Pet Specialization|Hunter|WoW|Beast Master|WoW|6} feature.

items.name: Mastery Property (Mastery)
items.entry: When you gain the Primal Companion feature and whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can choose your pet's family as one of the weapons for your Weapon Mastery feature. Then its mastery property applies to your primal companion's Beast's Strike attack.

entries.caption: Pet Families
rows: {@creature Beast of the Land|XPHB|Land} or {@creature Beast of the Sea|XPHB|Sea}
footnotes: *Unusual pet family; a hunter must acquire a special ability (typically by reading a magical tome) to tame an unusual pet.

entries.name: Playing a Mage
entries: To play a mage, choose the {@class Wizard|XPHB|Wizard class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You can choose one of three specializations to guide your choice of spells and feats: arcane, fire, or frost.
Adopting the {@class Wizard|XPHB} class, either at character creation or through multiclassing, increases a character's Renown Score with the Kirin Tor by 3 (see {@area chapter 4|30e|x}).

entries.name: Arcane Specialization
entries: Arcane mages manipulate raw arcane magic, destroying enemies with overwhelming power.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Light|XPHB}, {@spell Mage Hand|XPHB}, and {@spell Thunderclap|XPHB}. Choose these spells for your spellbook: {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB}, {@spell Mage Armor|XPHB}, {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB}, {@spell Shield|XPHB}, and {@spell Thunderwave|XPHB}.

entries.title: Chen Stormstout, a Pandaren Monk

entries.name: Playing a Monk
entries: To play a monk, choose the {@class Monk|XPHB|Monk class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You can choose one of three specializations to guide your choice of subclass and feats: brewmaster, mistweaver, or windwalker.

entries.name: Brewmaster Specialization
entries: Brewmaster monks inhabit the murky space between intoxication and the appearance of intoxication. They use a combination of powerful concoctions and unpredictable, staggering movements to enhance their own attacks and defenses and keep enemies off guard. Deceived by a brewmaster's apparent intoxication, enemies barely have time to process the monk's unpredictable behavior before being laid low by careful fist strikes.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@subclass Mystic Brews|Monk|WoW|WoW|Warrior of Mystic Brews subclass}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Chef|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Elusive Brawler|WoW}, {@feat Grappler|XPHB}, {@feat Sentinel|XPHB}, and {@feat Stagger and Sway|WoW}.

entries.name: Mistweaver Specialization
entries: Monks originated in Pandaria, where some of them learned from a Wild God called Yu'lon the Jade Serpent how to draw power from the magical mists that shrouded the continent for millennia. By weaving the mists, these monks wield the power of life's essence to heal wounds and sap their foes' life energy.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Monk|WoW|Warrior of Mercy subclass|Mercy|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Enveloping Mist|WoW}, {@feat Observant|XPHB}, {@feat Poisoner|XPHB}, {@feat Shadow-Touched|XPHB|Shadow Touched}, and {@feat Skulker|XPHB}.

entries.name: Windwalker Specialization
entries: Windwalker monks are the quintessential martial artists, fighting with mastery and grace. Through a combination of intense physical training and mystical discipline, they can unleash a dizzying flurry of punches and kicks to devastate their enemies.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Monk|WoW|Warrior of the Open Hand subclass|Open Hand|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Fists of Fury|WoW}, and {@feat Speedy|XPHB}.

entries.name: Monastic Orders of Pandaria
entries: Monks undergo rigorous physical and spiritual training within monasteries. Even those who learn a martial art from traveling masters can trace their art's origin back to a monastic order. The most notable monastic orders are the following.

entries.name: Crane Wing Order
entries: Under the guidance of the August Celestial Chi-Ji (one of the Wild Gods who watch over Pandaria), monks practice their art in the Temple of the Red Crane in Pandaria's Krasarang Wilds. Chi-Ji's teachings emphasize physical and emotional adaptability.

entries.name: Niuzao Sentinels
entries: A martial order serving the August Celestial Niuzao maintains a temple in Pandaria's Townlong Steppes. The stern sentinels of this order undergo rigorous emotional and physical training to ward against fear as they keep vigil over the Sha of Fear imprisoned in the catacombs beneath the temple.

entries.name: Order of the Broken Temple
entries: When the Burning Legion destroyed the Peak of Serenity in Pandaria, the survivors formed the Order of the Broken Temple on the mysterious Wandering Isle. They welcome monks of all kinds in an effort to hold strong against the Burning Legion.

entries.name: Order of the Cloud Serpent
entries: Some monks bond with Pandaria's flying cloud serpents to defend the Jade Forest. By cultivating hatchling cloud serpents and shepherding their growth to adulthood, these monks learn patience to temper their ambitions. The windwalker specialization represents these monks' bond with the skies.

entries.name: Shado-Pan
entries: The Watchers on the Wall are elite monks who protect Pandaria's peaceful way of life from internal and external threats. They operate across their realm from the Shado-Pan Monastery in Kun-Lai Summit and move through the shadows to strike suddenly against any foe.

entries.name: Monk Feats
entries: Elusive Brawler, Enveloping Mist, Fists of Fury, and Stagger and Sway are new General feats intended primarily for monks.

entries.title: Blood Elf Paladin

entries.name: Playing a Paladin
entries: To play a paladin, choose the {@class Paladin|XPHB|Paladin class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You can choose one of three specializations to guide your choice of subclass, spells, and feats: holy, protection, or retribution.

entries.name: Holy Specialization
entries: Holy paladins spend much of their lives in hallowed halls studying divine doctrine, learning to stand as beacons of the Light for their allies. They believe that evil must be eradicated from the world so that the Light can prevail, and they serve all who are engaged in this holy struggle. The Light, in turn, imbues holy paladins with the power to heal and revitalize their comrades.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Prepare the following level 1 spells to start: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB}. Choose at least one of {@item Flail|XPHB|Flails}, {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords}, {@item Morningstar|XPHB|Morningstars}, or {@item Warhammer|XPHB|Warhammers} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 2
items.entry: Choose {@feat Blessed Warrior|XPHB} instead of a Fighting Style feat, and choose {@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB} and {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB} as your cantrips.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@subclass Holy|Paladin|WoW|WoW|Oath of the Holy subclass}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Healer|XPHB}, {@feat Inspiring Leader|XPHB}, {@feat Shield Master|XPHB}, and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: War Clerics
entries: Although D&D's {@class Paladin|WoW} class is the best match for a paladin in {@i World of Warcraft}, if you want to play your paladin as a dedicated healer, you could also play a {@class Cleric|XPHB}. Choose the {@class Priest|WoW|War Domain subclass|War|WoW}, and otherwise follow the guidance for building a holy paladin as a {@class Paladin|WoW}.

entries.name: Protection Specialization
entries: Stalwart and steadfast, paladins who specialize in protection wield a weapon of righteous judgment in one hand and a shield of holy protection in the other. These paladins are ardent defenders of the Light and all that it touches, and the radiance of the Light invigorates and heals them in turn.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Prepare the following level 1 spells to start: {@spell Compelled Duel|XPHB} and {@spell Searing Smite|XPHB}. Choose at least one of {@item Battleaxe|XPHB|Battleaxes}, {@item Flail|XPHB|Flails}, {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords}, {@item Morningstar|XPHB|Morningstars}, or {@item Warhammer|XPHB|Warhammers} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 2
items.entry: Choose {@feat Interception|XPHB} or {@feat Protection|XPHB} as your Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Paladin|WoW|Oath of Devotion subclass|Devotion|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Heavy Armor Master|XPHB}, {@feat Sentinel|XPHB}, {@feat Shield Master|XPHB}, and {@feat Tough|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: Retribution Specialization
entries: The most dedicated paladins can become fanatical in their devotion, acting as instruments of retribution against those who dare to defy the Light. These paladins are vengeful guardians of the weak and crusaders who judge and punish the wicked. Their resolute conviction in the divine order of all things assures them that the Light's victory is inevitable, and so they fight to their last breath to ensure that the Light will prevail.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Prepare the following level 1 spells to start: {@spell Heroism|XPHB} and {@spell Wrathful Smite|XPHB}. Choose at least one of {@item Greataxe|XPHB|Greataxes}, {@item Greatsword|XPHB|Greatswords}, or {@item Maul|XPHB|Mauls} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 2
items.entry: Choose {@feat Great Weapon Fighting|XPHB} as your Fighting Style feat.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Paladin|WoW|Oath of Vengeance subclass|Vengeance|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Great Weapon Master|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.name: Paladin Spells
entries: The following new spells are added to the Paladin spell list for {@i World of Warcraft} paladins. In the Special column, {@i C} means the spell requires Concentration.

entries.title: Prophet Velen, a Draenei Priest

entries.name: Playing a Priest
entries: To play a priest, choose the {@class Cleric|XPHB|Cleric class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You can choose one of three specializations to guide your choice of subclass, spells, and other features: discipline, holy, or shadow. These specializations reflect varying degrees of devotion to the cosmic forces of Light and Shadow, with holy priests focusing on the Light, shadow priests drawing primarily on Shadow, and discipline priests balancing the two.

entries.name: Discipline Specialization
entries: Some priests pride themselves on pragmatism. They understand that light casts a shadow, that darkness is defined by light, and that true discipline stems from one's ability to balance these opposing powers in service of a greater cause. While these priests possess many holy virtues to aid their allies, they also dabble in the dark arts to debilitate their enemies—exercising immense discipline to prevent themselves from delving too far into the shadows. Many discipline priests believe the ends justify the means; they maximize their effectiveness by studying scriptures both virtuous and vile.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose Thaumaturge for your {@classFeature Divine Order|Cleric|XPHB|1|XPHB}. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Guidance|XPHB}, {@spell Resistance|XPHB}, {@spell Thaumaturgy|XPHB}, and {@spell Word of Radiance|XPHB}. Prepare the following spells to start: {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Guiding Bolt|XPHB}, {@spell Sanctuary|XPHB}, and {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB}.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@subclass Discipline|Priest|WoW|WoW|Discipline Domain subclass}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Inspiring Leader|XPHB}, {@feat Mage Slayer|XPHB}, and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider these spells as you gain levels.

entries.caption: Discipline Priest Spells
rows: {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Shadow Word: Pain|WoW}
{@spell Aura of Vitality|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Spirit Guardians|XPHB}
{@spell Flame Strike|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Summon Celestial|XPHB}

entries.name: Holy Specialization
entries: After spending much of their lives in temples studying ancient doctrine, preaching the tenets of their faith, and pledging their devotion to the divine powers they follow, the most adept priests leave their houses of worship to serve on the battlefield. There, they use their holy powers to bless allies and mend wounds. And while most stay behind the front lines to aid their comrades, these holy champions can also smite foes and carry out sacred justice. Holy priests are morally opposed to shadow magic. They are exemplars of the incredible grace and power of the divine and the Light.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose Thaumaturge for your {@classFeature Divine Order|Cleric|XPHB|1|XPHB}. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Guidance|XPHB}, {@spell Light|XPHB}, {@spell Sacred Flame|XPHB}, and {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB}. Prepare the following spells to start: {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB}, {@spell Healing Word|XPHB}, and {@spell Purify Food and Drink|XPHB}.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Priest|WoW|Life Domain subclass|Life|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Chef|XPHB}, {@feat Healer|XPHB}, {@feat Inspiring Leader|XPHB}, and {@feat War Caster|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.caption: Holy Priest Spells
rows: {@spell Detect Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Shadow Word: Pain|WoW}
{@spell Blur|XPHB}, {@spell Calm Emotions|XPHB}, {@spell Prayer of Healing|XPHB}, {@spell Protection from Poison|XPHB}
{@spell Beacon of Hope|XPHB}, {@spell Daylight|XPHB}, {@spell Prayer of Mending|WoW}
{@spell Aura of Purity|XPHB}, {@spell Guardian of Faith|XPHB}, {@spell Holy Nova|WoW}
{@spell Commune|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB}

entries.name: Shadow Specialization
entries: The Light in which many priests bathe is brilliant and effervescent, granting them immense divine power. But the brightest light casts the darkest shadow—and within this shadow, a rival power dwells. Shadow priests fully embrace this polarity, their resolute faith focused on shadowy magics and mental manipulation. They derive their power from the Void, straying dangerously close to the domain of the Old Gods and its ancient, corruptive influence. This is the state in which these dark priests thrive, feeding off of the minds of their opponents to reach terrifying new limits.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose Thaumaturge for your {@classFeature Divine Order|Cleric|XPHB|1|XPHB}. Choose the following cantrips: {@spell Mending|XPHB}, {@spell Resistance|XPHB}, {@spell Thaumaturgy|XPHB}, and {@spell Toll the Dead|XPHB}. Prepare the following spells to start: {@spell Bane|XPHB}, {@spell Command|XPHB}, {@spell Healing Word|XPHB}, and {@spell Shadow Word: Pain|WoW}.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@subclass Shadow|Priest|WoW|WoW|Shadow Domain subclass}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Actor|XPHB}, {@feat Mage Slayer|XPHB}, {@feat Shadow-Touched|XPHB|Shadow Touched}, {@feat Skulker|XPHB}, and {@feat Telepathic|XPHB}.

items.name: Spells
items.entry: Consider the spells on the table below as you gain levels.

entries.caption: Shadow Priest Spells
rows: {@spell Bestow Curse|XPHB}, {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Speak with Dead|XPHB}
{@spell Banishment|XPHB}, {@spell Freedom of Movement|XPHB}, {@spell Locate Creature|XPHB}

entries.title: Tyrande Whisperwind, a Night Elf Priest

entries.name: Priest Spells
entries: The following spells from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB} and new spells (marked with an asterisk) are added to the Cleric spell list for {@i World of Warcraft} priests. In the Special column, {@i C} means the spell requires Concentration and {@i M} means it requires a specific Material component.

entries.name: Faiths of the Light and Shadow
entries: Priests in Azeroth belong to several notable faiths related to the Light and Shadow.

items.name: Holy Light
items.entry: Many peoples across Azeroth revere the Holy Light as an abstract force or as a personified being. The Church of the Holy Light is the most prominent religious body in the world, devoted to the pure ideals of the Light as revealed in visions sent by the naaru. This faith is predominant among humans, dwarves, gnomes, high and blood elves, and draenei. A similar faith, the Church of the Sacred Flame, was brought east across the sea by the humans and high elves who founded the Empire of Arathor.

items.name: Sun and Moon
items.entry: Tauren revere the sun deity An'she as the right eye of the Earth Mother, with the moon (a being of Life), Mu'she, being her left eye. Night elves also revere a moon deity, Elune, who is associated with both the power of nature and the Holy Light.

items.name: Old Gods
items.entry: Most priests view Shadow as a dark mirror of the Light, but some revere it in the form of Old Gods or void lords. The Twilight's Hammer is the most widespread cult of the Old Gods, but less destructive faiths also draw on Shadow power. Most notable among these is the Cult of the Forgotten Shadow, founded by Forsaken priests who believed themselves abandoned or betrayed by the Light. Followers of the Forgotten Shadow wield Void power but believe it's important to understand the Light as well, balancing these opposed forces.

items.name: Lok'osh
items.entry: Many orc priests practice Lok'osh, a path of healing and renewal that draws on "songs of life and shadow" found within each practitioner's heart and spirit. Priests within this tradition focus on Light and Void powers to varying degrees, but the path of the Lok'osh prevents priests from straying too far into the corruption of the Void.

entries.title: Worgen Rogue

entries.name: Playing a Rogue
entries: To play a rogue, choose the {@class Rogue|XPHB|Rogue class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. You can choose one of three specializations to guide your choice of subclass and feats: assassination, outlaw, or subtlety.

entries.name: Assassination Specialization
entries: Rogues who specialize in assassination use poison extensively, often wielding a pair of daggers coated with deadly toxins.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@item Dagger|XPHB|Daggers} and {@item Shortbow|XPHB|Shortbows} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Rogue|WoW|Assassin subclass|Assassin|WoW}.

items.name: Level 5
items.entry: Frequently use the Poison option for your {@classFeature Cunning Strike|Rogue|XPHB|5|XPHB}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Actor|XPHB}, {@feat Alert|XPHB}, {@feat Defensive Duelist|XPHB}, {@feat Piercer|XPHB}, {@feat Poisoner|XPHB}, {@feat Skulker|XPHB}, and {@feat Speedy|XPHB}.

entries.name: Outlaw Specialization
entries: Rogues with the outlaw specialization are ruthless swashbucklers who use agility and guile to dominate in combat while standing toe-to-toe with their enemies. Many of these rogues are affiliated with outlaw bands like the Defias Brotherhood and the pirates of Booty Bay.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@item Dagger|XPHB|Daggers} and {@item Rapier|XPHB|Rapiers} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@subclass Swashbuckler|Rogue|WoW|WoW|Swashbuckler subclass}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Athlete|XPHB}, {@feat Defensive Duelist|XPHB}, {@feat Martial Weapon Training|XPHB}, {@feat Piercer|XPHB}, {@feat Speedy|XPHB}, and {@feat Tough|XPHB}.

entries.name: Subtlety Specialization
entries: Rogues who specialize in subtlety draw on the supernatural magic of the shadows to cloak themselves in darkness and form deadly blades. They strike from hiding, incapacitate their enemies with an overwhelming assault of rapid attacks, and disappear just as quickly back into the shadows.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose {@item Dagger|XPHB|Daggers} and {@item Mace|XPHB|Maces} for your Weapon Mastery.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Rogue|WoW|Soulknife subclass|Soulknife|WoW}.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Dual Wielder|XPHB}, {@feat Mage Slayer|XPHB}, {@feat Shadow-Touched|XPHB|Shadow Touched}, and {@feat Skulker|XPHB}.

entries: Anything worth doing is worth doing with panache.

entries.title: Vol'jin, a Troll Shadow Hunter Who Wields Shamanic Magic

entries.name: Playing a Shaman
entries: To play a shaman, choose the {@class Barbarian|XPHB|Barbarian class} from the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}. At level 3, you gain the Totems feature described below instead of the {@classFeature Primal Knowledge|Barbarian|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature. You can choose one of three specializations to guide your choice of subclass, feats, and weapons: elemental, enhancement, or restoration.

Adopting the {@class Barbarian|XPHB} class as a shaman, either at character creation or through multiclassing, increases a character's Renown Score with the Earthen Ring by 3 (see {@area chapter 4|300|x}).

entries.name: Level 3: Totems
entries: This feature replaces the Barbarian's {@classFeature Primal Knowledge|Barbarian|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature.

You can coalesce elemental spirits into a totem that aids you and your allies. As a Bonus Action, you can plant one of the totems below into the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of yourself.

A totem is a Small object that has AC 10 and 1 Hit Point and lasts for 1 minute, until it drops to 0 Hit Points, or until you use this feature again. At the end of each of your turns, the totem pulses with elemental energy that fills a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

entries.name: Earthbind Totem
entries: Each enemy in the Emanation has its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Primal Knowledge Totem
entries: Each ally in the Emanation is empowered with nature's focus until the end of your next turn. While empowered in this way, whenever the creature makes an ability check using one of the following skills, the creature can make it as a Strength check even if it normally uses a different ability: {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, {@skill Stealth|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB}. After you plant this totem, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of this totem by expending one use of your {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB} (no action required).

entries.name: Tremor Totem
entries: Each ally in the Emanation has Immunity to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions until the end of your next turn. If the creature was already Charmed or Frightened, those conditions are suppressed until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Wind Rush Totem
entries: Each ally in the Emanation has its Speed increased by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Specialization
entries: Shaman with the elemental specialization dedicate themselves to forging deep bonds with the elements. Inspired by visions of an ancient past where manifestations of volatile energy once raged unimpeded across primordial Azeroth, these shaman devote themselves to channeling such power into destructive magical surges. The raw elemental energy of storms—lightning, fire, and cold—flow through their bodies as they summon spirits to their aid.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose any two of {@item Battleaxe|XPHB|Battleaxes}, {@item Longsword|XPHB|Longswords}, or {@item Mace|XPHB|Maces} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@subclass Elements|Shaman|WoW|WoW|Path of the Elements subclass}. You also gain the Totems feature in place of the Barbarian's {@classFeature Primal Knowledge|Barbarian|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature, as described above.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Athlete|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Medium Armor Master|XPHB}, {@feat Ritual Caster|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

entries.name: Enhancement Specialization
entries: Shaman who specialize in enhancement empower their physical attacks with elemental energy as they wade into the thick of combat. They supplement their augmented weapon attacks with potent elemental strikes and totems.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose any two of {@item Handaxe|XPHB|Handaxes}, {@item Light Hammer|XPHB|Light Hammers}, {@item Scimitar|XPHB|Scimitars}, or {@item Shortsword|XPHB|Shortswords} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@subclass Spiritual Guardian|Shaman|WoW|WoW|Path of the Spiritual Guardian subclass}. You also gain the Totems feature in place of the Barbarian's {@classFeature Primal Knowledge|Barbarian|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature, as described above.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Athlete|XPHB}, {@feat Charger|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Dual Wielder|XPHB}, {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Medium Armor Master|XPHB}, and {@feat Slasher|XPHB}.

entries.name: Restoration Specialization
entries: Shaman who specialize in restoration find a serene affinity for the restorative properties of water. They feel a profound spiritual connection with the source from which all mortal life takes root, and they wield that power to restore vitality to their allies. These shaman balance this healing focus with a command of the other elements, finding harmony in nature and purifying their allies as a tidal surge washes across a sandy shore.
The following choices will help you focus on this specialization:

items.name: Level 1
items.entry: Choose any two of {@item Flail|XPHB|Flails}, {@item Mace|XPHB|Maces}, or {@item Warhammer|XPHB|Warhammers} for your Weapon Mastery feature.

items.name: Level 3
items.entry: Choose the {@class Shaman|WoW|Path of the World Tree subclass|World Tree|WoW}. You also gain the Totems feature in place of the Barbarian's {@classFeature Primal Knowledge|Barbarian|XPHB|3|XPHB} feature, as described above.

items.name: Feats
items.entry: Consider the following feats at higher levels: {@feat Chef|XPHB}, {@feat Crusher|XPHB}, {@feat Durable|XPHB}, {@feat Inspiring Leader|XPHB}, {@feat Medium Armor Master|XPHB}, {@feat Sentinel|XPHB}, and {@feat Shield Master|XPHB}.
